label: Muse Spark open (Baseten, direct API)
note: Trial frozen takes with --backend baseten, mirroring the demo/frozen commands one for one. Direct OpenAI-compatible calls to inference.baseten.co; usage figures are model-only, unlike the ACP takes in demo/frozen. These are evidence, not the demo take: see quality notes per beat — several takes do not meet the curated bar and demo/frozen keeps the Muse Wonder takes.

takes.name: drafted verdict data
takes.quality: good — draft validates, reaches its own verdict 'skip it for now', same story as the Wonder take

takes.name: live repair take
commands: KNAP_TEMPLATES_DIR=/tmp/seeded knap-mcp repair verdict -d data/verdict.sample.json --target markdown --backend baseten --out ../demo/frozen-baseten/03-repaired.md > ../demo/frozen-baseten/03-repair.json
takes.quality: fails the curated bar — converged:true in 1 iteration, but the patch 'fixed' the unclosed {% if %} by deleting the doc body (repaired.md is frontmatter only, 332 B vs clean 2205 B). Renders with no diagnostics, so convergence is technically met while the result is semantically wrong. Kept as evidence for the repair-convergence finding.

takes.name: live ratchet take
takes.quality: weak — stalls at 43.9 vs 60.4 ceiling after 3 iterations, 4 declined slots, converged:false. Shows the loop working but underwhelming on tape.

takes.name: live voice, mild and feral
commands: knap-mcp voice verdict -d data/verdict.sample.json --tone mild --backend baseten > ../demo/frozen-baseten/06-voice-mild.json
knap-mcp voice verdict -d data/verdict.sample.json --tone feral --backend baseten > ../demo/frozen-baseten/06-voice-feral.json
takes.quality: mixed — feral keeps the structhash; mild does not (rewrote field values, e.g. verdict 'give a shit' -> 'worth caring about', plus inserted emphasis). The same-suite run in eval/results/live/baseten reported both tones layout-identical, so this is run-to-run variance — evidence for the voice value-rewrite finding.
